data.name: RV Life Sim
data.detailed_description:
You are no longer a child. It's time to leave home, and all you have is your grandfather's old RV. Answer the call of the open road. RV Life Sim is an open-world nomad survival adventure that brings together long-distance drives, wilderness exploration, and a mobile crafting economy. Work, earn money, craft, sell, trade, and survive! Chase the horizon, discover new cities, camp under the stars, head down to the city to buy new clothes or camping gear from the shopping mall, and build a self-sufficient life over time.

KEY FEATURES

🛣️ Your Home on Wheels and the Open Road Start your adventure by transforming an inherited old RV into your home on the road. Plan long routes across changing climates, keep your engine and mechanical parts in working order, and manage your fuel, food, rest, and trade throughout your journey.

🛠️ Craft, Trade, Survive Every kilometer has a cost, so turn your RV into your own business. Gather raw materials from nature, buy cheap resources like waste oil from towns, refine them into fuel, craft products inside your RV, and manage your cash, fuel, and supplies by trading with towns. Work to earn, or craft and trade to win!

🔧 Upgrade, Expand, Renew Reinvest the money you earn back into your RV. Add interior decorations, expand your storage space, and boost your engine for rough terrains. Once you save up enough, replace your grandfather's old RV with a newer model.

🛍️ Shop, Find Your Style Head to the city to buy new shoes and clothes from the shopping mall, and decorate your RV exactly to your taste.

🌲 Camp Under the Stars When the sun sets, set up camp anywhere you want in the vast wilderness. Pitch your tent, cook meals with what you've gathered, rest under the stars, and wake up to a brand-new horizon every single morning, featuring stunning, uninterrupted vistas that stretch as far as the eye can see.

---

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 A FAMILY-FRIENDLY JOURNEY

RV Life Sim offers a peaceful, relaxing, and wholesome simulation designed for players of all ages. With no intense violence or stress, it is a perfect experience to enjoy at your own pace, making it suitable for the entire family.

🚗 FUTURE CO-OP ROAD TRIPS

While the initial release focuses entirely on a polished single-player experience, a multiplayer Co-op mode is actively planned for future updates. You will be able to invite your friends, manage your RV together, and share the ultimate road trip adventure!

data.short_description: Chase the horizon and make a living along the way. Camp under open skies, craft and trade goods with nearby towns, and keep your RV rolling on long-distance journeys through a vast wilderness. Build your ultimate home on wheels today!
data.supported_languages:
English*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Russian, Turkish, Italian
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: System requirements are preliminary and subject to change during development.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700K / AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 / AMD Radeon RX 6800 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended.
